title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Foster Moreau hauls in two touchdown passes in Week 6
items.desc: Foster Moreau caught both of his targets for seven yards and two touchdowns in the Texans' 34-31 win over Jacksonville.
items.impact: Moreau has not seen enough playing time this season to be fantasy viable weekly. His two touchdown performance will spark some interest on the waiver wire, but it will be hard to trust the veteran moving forward.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Dalton Schultz hauls in four passes in Week 6
items.desc: Dalton Schultz caught 4-of-6 targets for 33 yards in the Texans' 34-31 win over the Jaguars.
items.impact: Schultz's six targets are his most since a Week 2 performance that saw him log 12 receptions on 14 targets. Foster Moreau was targeted more in the end zone, resulting in two touchdowns Sunday. The veteran remains an emergency start at best for fantasy managers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Xavier Hutchinson held to two receptions in Week 6
items.desc: Xavier Hutchinson caught 2-of-3 targets for 10 yards in a 34-31 win over Jacksonville.
items.impact: Hutchinson logged his lowest receiving totals of the season in the win Sunday. With the addition of Marvin Harrison Jr. to the roster, Hutchinson's role will be limited and he should be left off fantasy rosters for now.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Kayshon Boutte held to two receptions in Week 6
items.desc: Kayshon Boutte caught 2-of-3 targets for 16 yards in a 34-31 win over Jacksonville.
items.impact: Boutte continues to see limited targets in his first year in Houston, and will likely see even less with the addition of Marvin Harrison Jr. via trade. Fantasy managers should only view Boutte as an option in deeper formats.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. hauls in three passes in Week 6
items.desc: Marvin Harrison Jr. caught 3-of-4 targets for 34 yards in a 34-31 win over Jacksonville.
items.impact: Harrison was making his debut for Houston and was figured to only factor into a handful of plays. Despite that, his three receptions tie a season high and the Texans are clearly high on the 24-year-old. Harrison and the Texans will take on the Giants in Week 7.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jaylin Noel finds the end zone in Week 6 win
items.desc: Jaylin Noel caught all four of his targets for 107 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 34-31 win over Jacksonville.
items.impact: Noel found the end zone on a 13-yard connection from C.J Stroud in the third quarter. Noel has shown a positive rapport with Stroud, but will likely remain behind Nico Collins in the pass catcher pecking order for the duration of the season.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Nico Collins hauls in three passes in Week 6 win
items.desc: Nico Collins caught 3-of-5 targets for 74 yards in the Texans' 34-31 win over Jacksonville. Collins also added five rushing yards on one carry.
items.impact: Collins saw his production drop with C.J. Stroud spreading the ball around to 10 different pass catchers. He will look to bounce back against a weak Giants' secondary in Week 7.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jawhar Jordan finds the end zone in Week 6 win
items.desc: Jawhar Jordan rushed for 43 yards and a touchdown on six carries in a 34-31 win over Jacksonville. He caught his lone target for seven yards.
items.impact: Jordan was elevated from the practice squad to provide depth in the backfield with David Montgomery sidelined with a groin injury. Fantasy managers should expect Jordan to remain on the roster to backup Woody Marks if Montgomery is sidelined again in Week 7.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Woody Marks sees 17 touches in Week 6 win
items.desc: Woody Marks rushed for 56 yards on 15 carries in the Texans' 34-31 win over the Jaguars. He caught 2-of-3 targets for 25 yards.
items.impact: Marks led the running back room in touches, but did see Jawhar Jordan score the lone rushing touchdown for Houston. Fantasy managers should expect Marks and Jordan to continue to get work if David Montgomery (groin) is forced to miss more time.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: C.J. Stroud tosses three touchdowns in Week 6 win
items.desc: C.J. Stroud completed 24-of-34 pass attempts for 312 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in the win over the Jaguars. He rushed for five yards on his lone rushing attempt.
items.impact: Stroud found 10 different pass catchers as he spread the ball around effectively and kept the Jaguars' defense guessing. Stroud has eclipsed 300 yards passing in three games this season and set a new season high with three touchdown passes. Houston will take on the Giants in Week 7.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Ladd McConkey (concussion) knocked out of Sunday's game
items.desc: Ladd McConkey taken out of Sunday's game early due to a concussion.
items.impact: The setbacks just continue for McConkey this season. He worked through a foot injury at practice this week. Now, he'll enter the league's concussion protocol after exiting Sunday's game against the Chiefs in the second quarter. McConkey made just one reception for 17 yards prior to leaving.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) inactive for Week 6
items.desc: DJ Moore (shoulder) is inactive for Week 6 for the Buffalo Bills against the Las Vegas Raiders.
items.impact: Moore will be sidelined for the second consecutive week as the wideout continues to battle through a shoulder injury. Keon Coleman and Khalil Shakir will see increased targets in Moore's absence against the Raiders Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) questionable to return
items.desc: Patriots WR Romeo Doubs (shoulder) is questionable to return Sunday against the Jets.
items.impact: Doubs appeared to suffer the shoulder injury on his touchdown reception in the first quarter. The Patriots should update his status after halftime.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Carson Steele (shoulder) questionable to return
items.desc: Eagles RB Carson Steele (shoulder) is questionable to return Sunday against Carolina.
items.impact: Steele suffered the injury in the first quarter and was taken to the locker room for further evaluation. Dameon Pierce will continue to see the bulk of the touches at running back, with Jaydon Blue serving as the primary backup if Steele cannot return.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) officially active for Week 6
items.desc: Steelers RB Rico Dowdle (toe) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with Tampa Bay.
items.impact: Dowdle has dealt with a toe injury that has kept him sidelined since Week 2. Jaylen Warren will likely still see the bulk of the carries, but Dowdle's return will result in less work for Warren.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Pat Freiermuth (calf) officially active for Week 6
items.desc: Steelers TE Pat Freiermuth (calf) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with Tampa Bay.
items.impact: Freiermuth was a late addition to the injury report this week, but has been cleared to play after pregame warmups. The veteran has appeared more involved in the offense as of late, scoring three touchdowns in his last two games.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) officially active for Week 6
items.desc: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Jets.
items.impact: Henderson was listed as questionable due to a high-ankle sprain he suffered last week. Even with Henderson active, Rhamondre Stevenson will likely see the bulk of the carries for the Patriots against the Jets.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Trevor Etienne (ankle) is officially active for Week 6
items.desc: Panthers RB Trevor Etienne (ankle) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with  the Eagles.
items.impact: Etienne will make his 2026 debut for the Panthers Sunday. Etienne will serve as the primary backup to Chuba Hubbard for the Panthers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Sean Tucker (quad) officially inactive for Week 6
items.desc: Buccaneers RB Sean Tucker (quad) is officially inactive against the Steelers.
items.impact: Tucker was listed as questionable as he continues to deal with a nagging quad injury. Kenny Gainwell will serve as the primary backup to Bucky Irving.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Hollywood Brown officially inactive for Week 6
items.desc: Eagles WR Hollywood Brown is officially inactive for a Week 6 matchup with the Panthers.
items.impact: Brown was off the final injury report this week, so he may be a healthy inactive. He will have to wait at least one more game before making his 2026 debut.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Chris Olave (illness) officially active for Week 6
items.desc: Saints WR Chris Olave (illness) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Giants.
items.impact: Olave was able to practice Friday but was listed as questionable to play as a precaution. The Saints will have their top pass catcher active against the Giants.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Alvin Kamara (back) officially active for Week 6
items.desc: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Giants.
items.impact: Kamara was considered questionable to play after being limited in practice throughout the week. Kamara is likely a flex play at best in deeper leagues right now.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyrique Stevenson Sr. (hip) officially inactive for Week 6
items.desc: Bears DB Tyrique Stevenson Sr. (hip) is officially inactive for a Week 6 matchup with the Falcons.
items.impact: Stevenson was limited in practice all week and will not be available against Drake London and the Falcons. Kyler Gordon (calf) was questionable to play, but is active and will suit up for the Bears.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq (concussion) officially active for Week 6
items.desc: Jets TE Kenyon Sadiq (concussion) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Patriots.
items.impact: Sadiq has cleared concussion protocol and will play against the Patriots after being listed questionable heading into Sunday. Sadiq and Mason Taylor will likely split time at tight end against New England.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyler Warren (groin) officially inactive for Week 6
items.desc: Colts TE Tyler Warren (groin) is officially inactive for Week 6.
items.impact: Warren was a late addition to the injury report this week and was only able to practice in a limited capacity Friday. Mo Alie-Cox will see the bulk of the playing time at tight end against the Titans.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) officially active for Week 6
items.desc: Titans RB Tyjae Spears (knee) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Colts.
items.impact: Spears was considered questionable to play as he continues to deal with a minor knee injury. Fantasy managers should expect both Spears and Tony Pollard to be involved in the Titans' backfield.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) will not play Sunday
items.desc: Browns RB Quinshon Judkins (ankle) will not play against the Ravens Sunday.
items.impact: Judkins was listed as questionable to play this week and only practiced Friday for the Browns. With Judkins sidelined, 	Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime will see the bulk of the playing time at running back for the Browns.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Devin Singletary expected to be active Sunday
items.desc: Devin Singletary is expected to be active for the New York Giants Sunday according to Jordan Raanan.
items.impact: Singletary is part of a backfield shakeup for head coach John Harbaugh after Cam Skattebo's ball security issues, with the veteran to be part of a four-headed backfield attack along with Najee Harris, Tyrone Tracy Jr, and Skattebo Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Najee Harris to see increased workload in Week 6
items.desc: Najee Harris will receive an increased workload for the New York Giants Sunday according to Jordan Raanan.
items.impact: Harris will look to take advantage of increased opportunities for head coach John Harbaugh after Cam Skattebo struggled with ball security, with Devin Singletary and Tyrone Tracy Jr. also expected to be active Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Mason Graham (knee/ankle) not expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Mason Graham (knee/ankle) is not expected to play for the Cleveland Browns Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Graham struggled to reach the practice field throughout the week for head coach Todd Monken and barring anything unforeseen will leave the Cleveland defensive front shorthanded against the Ravens Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) could return in Week 7
items.desc: There's reportedly "optimism" Baker Mayfield will return in Week 7 against the Panthers.
items.impact: Mayfield didn't practice this week, but he resumed throwing on Monday. His status will need to be monitored in practice next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alec Pierce (heel) weeks away from returning
items.desc: Colts WR Alec Pierce is still a few weeks away from a return to game action.
items.impact: Pierce was able to get out of his cast earlier this week. He remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) not practicing yet
items.desc: Packers EDGE Micah Parsons still isn't practicing yet.
items.impact: The earliest Parsons may return is Week 9 according to Tom Pelissero. The Packers will play at least a few games without him.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) ruled out Monday
items.desc: Jacory Croskey-Merritt has been ruled out for Monday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Croskey-Merritt was unable to practice this week. Rachaad White and Austin Ekeler will lead the Commanders backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) listed questionable Monday
items.desc: Stefon Diggs is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Diggs returned to practice on Friday. He'll be a game-time decision on Monday, but he seems to be trending in the right direction.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Roman Wilson (finger) placed on IR
items.desc: The Steelers placed Roman Wilson on injured reserve.
items.impact: Wilson injured his finger last week. He will miss at least the next four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marcus Mariota (knee) ruled out Monday
items.desc: Marcus Mariota has been ruled out for Monday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Mariota will miss his second straight game. Athan Kaliakmanis will continue to serve as the primary backup to Jayden Daniels.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: A.J. Brown (ankle) activated from IR
items.desc: The Patriots activated A.J. Brown from injured reserve.
items.impact: Brown will make his return for the first time since Week 1. He'll be a WR2 with some risk in his first game back for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) ruled out Monday
items.desc: Deebo Samuel Sr. has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Samuel will miss at least one game as expected. He remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) listed questionable Monday
items.desc: Mike Evans has been listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Evans was unable to practice through Friday. He will be a game-time decision on Monday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Kirk (calf) listed questionable Monday
items.desc: Christian Kirk has been listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Kirk could make his return from injured reserve. We likely won't know his status till Monday.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) activated off of IR, will play against Cleveland
items.desc: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) has been activated from IR, clearing the way for him to return against Cleveland.
items.impact: Lane has been out since fracturing his wrist in Week 1, so it will be interesting to see what his snap counts and route shares look like after the IR stint. The team praised him all offseason and focused on him during his brief playing time in Week 1, so hopefully he will be able to find himself a decent role as the WR2 of the offense.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) starting for the Bears Sunday
items.desc: Caleb Williams (hamstring) is the starter for the Bears on Sunday against the Falcons. After a few weeks' absence, the franchise QB is back.
items.impact: Williams was initially questionable to play, but the Bears are now planning on getting him back in the lineup after a week of practice where he took starter reps. It will be interesting to see Caleb in a more "regular" game and how it affects the pass catchers, who have only played with Caleb in one normal game, and even that "normal" game saw copious amounts of production from the running backs.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) placed on IR
items.desc: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) has been placed on IR due to a blood clot.
items.impact: At first the Eagles were not going to place him on IR, but after further consultations, they have decided to make that move. Tanner McKee will start in his place for at least the next four games, with Carolina on tap tomorrow. All the pass catchers will likely see a downtick in production, but should still be usable if McKee is halfway decent.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DK Metcalf (illness) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: DK Metcalf is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Metcalf had been listed as questionable with an illness. He'll be good to go with the Steelers wide receiver room depleted.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mykel Williams (knee) limited in practice Friday
items.desc: Mykel Williams was limited in practice on Friday.
items.impact: Williams will need to be monitored in practice on Saturday ahead of Monday's game against the Commanders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: James Thompson Jr. (ankle) limited in practice Friday
items.desc: James Thompson Jr. was officially limited in practice on Friday.
items.impact: Thompson will need to be monitored in practice on Saturday ahead of Monday's game against the Commanders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Upton Stout (shoulder) limited in practice Friday
items.desc: Upton Stout was limited in practice on Friday.
items.impact: Stout will need to be monitored in practice on Saturday ahead of Monday's game against the Commanders.
